items.title: 6.3.3 Other Standard Forms of the Parabola (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Book p. 184-186: 6.3.3 other standard forms, table of the four forms with sketches, Example 17 with Figure 6.13.

blocks.text: Ab tak hamara parabola daayen taraf khulta tha kyun ke directrix focus ke baayen thi. Agar directrix focus ke daayen, ya focus ke neeche ya upar rakh dein to parabola baayen, upar ya neeche khulega. Is tarah teen aur standard forms milte hain. Sab ki equations bilkul usi tareeqe se banti hain jo 6.3.1 mein dekha.
Neeche wala table charon forms ki ahem baatein ek jagah dikhata hai.

Table parhne ka tareeqa: har column ek parabola hai aur har row us ki ek khoobi. Misaal ke taur par teesra column \(x^{2} = 4ay\) dekhiye: focus \((0, a)\), yaani \(y\)-axis par upar; directrix \(y = -a\), yaani neeche ek horizontal line; axis \(x = 0\), yaani \(y\)-axis khud; aur latus rectum \(y = a\), focus se guzarti horizontal line. Har column ko isi tarah zabani bol kar parhiye.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Charon forms ko ek nazar mein kaise pehchanein? Do sawal poochiye:
Kaun sa letter square hai? \(y^{2}\) ho to axis \(x\)-axis hai aur curve daayen ya baayen khulta hai. \(x^{2}\) ho to axis \(y\)-axis hai aur curve upar ya neeche khulta hai.
Doosri taraf sign kya hai? \(+4a\) ho to positive taraf (daayen ya upar), \(-4a\) ho to negative taraf (baayen ya neeche).
Focus hamesha curve ke khule hisse ke andar, vertex se \(a\) units door hota hai; directrix doosri taraf, woh bhi vertex se \(a\) units door. Jaise pyala: focus pyale ke andar, directrix pyale ke neeche.

Table ko ratne ki zaroorat nahi. Sirf pehla column (\(y^{2} = 4ax\)) achhi tarah samajh lein; baqi teen us ke 'aks' hain. \(y^{2} = -4ax\) pehle wale ka aaine mein ulta (baayen-daayen) aks hai, is liye focus aur directrix ke signs ulat jaate hain. \(x^{2} = \pm 4ay\) mein \(x\) aur \(y\) ki jagah badal di gayi hai, is liye focus \((a, 0)\) ki jagah \((0, a)\) ho jata hai aur directrix \(x = -a\) ki jagah \(y = -a\).

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: \(x^{2} = -12y\) kis taraf khulta hai aur is ka focus kahan hai? (\(x^{2}\) hai to axis \(y\)-axis; sign negative to neeche khulta hai; \(4a = 12\) se \(a = 3\); focus \((0, -3)\), directrix \(y = 3\).)

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Shift kiya hua parabola (hamari taraf se izafa, Example 17 aur exercise mein zaroori). Agar vertex origin ki jagah \((h, k)\) par ho to \(x\) ki jagah \(x - h\) aur \(y\) ki jagah \(y - k\) likhein:
\[(y - k)^{2} = \pm 4a(x - h)\]
\[(x - h)^{2} = \pm 4a(y - k)\]
Sab kuch vertex ke saath saath khisak jata hai, jaise poora naqsha utha kar doosri jagah rakh diya ho. Misaal: \((x - h)^{2} = 4a(y - k)\) ke liye focus \((h, k + a)\), directrix \(y = k - a\), axis \(x = h\). Agar equation \(x^{2} + Dx + Ey + F = 0\) jaisi ho to \(x\) mein complete square kar ke is shakal mein layein.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: Agar parabola ka vertex \((1, -2)\) ho, woh upar khulta ho aur \(a = 3\) ho, to us ki equation kya hogi? (\((x - 1)^{2} = 12(y + 2)\).) Is ka focus kahan hoga? (Vertex se 3 units upar: \((1, 1)\).) Aur directrix? (Vertex se 3 units neeche: \(y = -5\).) Dekhiye, table ka har jawab bas vertex ke hisaab se khisak gaya.

Yaad rakhiye ke shift karne se parabola ki shakal aur size nahi badalte; sirf us ki jagah badalti hai. Is liye \(a\) aur latus rectum ki lambai \(4a\) wohi rehti hai jo standard form mein thi. Badalte sirf coordinates hain: vertex, focus, aur directrix aur axis ki equations.

Ab Example 17 dekhte hain. Yahan parabola ka vertex origin par nahi hai. Hum complete square se us ka asal vertex dhoondenge, axes ko wahan shift karenge, aur phir table istemal karenge. Yeh tareeqa exercise ke kai sawalon mein bilkul isi tarah lagega.

Complete the square (poora square banana) ka tareeqa yaad kar lein, kyun ke yahan har jagah lagega: \(x^{2} + bx\) mein \(\left(\frac{b}{2}\right)^{2}\) jama karne se \(\left(x + \frac{b}{2}\right)^{2}\) ban jata hai. Misaal: \(x^{2} - 4x\) mein \(\left(\frac{-4}{2}\right)^{2} = 4\) jama kiya to \((x - 2)^{2}\). Jo cheez ek taraf jama ki, doosri taraf bhi jama karni hai, warna equation ka tawazun (balance) bigar jata hai, jaise tarazu ke ek palre mein wazan daal kar doosre mein na daalna.

blocks.title: Example 17
blocks.problem: Analyze the parabola \(x^{2} - 4x - 4y - 2 = 0\) and sketch its graph.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(x^{2} - 4x - 4y - 2 = 0\) ...(1)
Maloom karna: focus, axis, vertex, directrix, latus rectum ki lambai, aur graph ka sketch.
Tareeqa: sirf \(x\) ka square hai, is liye parabola ka axis vertical hai (upar ya neeche khulega). \(x\) mein complete square kar ke \((x - h)^{2} = 4a(y - k)\) ki shakal banayenge; phir axes shift kar ke standard form \(X^{2} = 4aY\) milegi aur table se sab kuch parh lenge.

Qadam 1: Complete the square
\[x^{2} - 4x = 4y + 2\]
\[x^{2} - 4x + 4 = 4y + 6\]
\[(x - 2)^{2} = 4\left(y + \dfrac{3}{2}\right)\ \text{...(2)}\]
Kyun: \(x\) wale terms baayen rakhe aur dono taraf \((\frac{-4}{2})^{2} = 4\) jama kiya, taake baayan hissa poora square ban jaye. Daayen taraf \(4y + 6 = 4(y + \frac{3}{2})\): \(y\) ka coefficient 4 bahar nikala.
Dhyan dein: 4 dono taraf jama karna hai, sirf ek taraf nahi.

Qadam 2: Axes shift karein
Maan lijiye \(x - 2 = X\) aur \(y + \frac{3}{2} = Y\). To (2) ban jati hai
\[X^{2} = 4Y\ \text{...(3)}\]
Kyun: is se origin us point par chala gaya jahan \(X = 0\), \(Y = 0\). (3) bilkul standard form \(X^{2} = 4aY\) hai jahan \(4a = 4\), yaani \(a = 1\); yeh upar (\(+Y\) ki taraf) khulta hai.

Qadam 3: Focus
\(X^{2} = 4aY\) ka focus \((0, a)\) hai: \(X = 0\), \(Y = 1\), yaani
\[x - 2 = 0,\quad y + \dfrac{3}{2} = 1\]
\[x = 2,\quad y = -\dfrac{1}{2}\]
Is liye (1) ka focus \(\left(2, -\frac{1}{2}\right)\) hai.
Kyun: pehle naye axes mein table se focus parha, phir \(x = X + 2\), \(y = Y - \frac{3}{2}\) se wapas purane \(x, y\) mein le aaye.

Qadam 4: Axis
(3) ka axis \(X = 0\) hai, yaani \(x - 2 = 0\): \(x = 2\) (1) ka axis hai.
Kyun: \(X^{2} = 4aY\) ka axis \(Y\)-axis hai, jis ki equation \(X = 0\) hai.

Qadam 5: Vertex
(3) ka vertex: \(X = 0\), \(Y = 0\), yaani
\[x - 2 = 0,\quad y + \dfrac{3}{2} = 0\]
\[x = 2,\quad y = -\dfrac{3}{2}\]
Yeh (1) ke vertex ke coordinates hain: \(\left(2, -\frac{3}{2}\right)\).
Kyun: vertex naya origin hi hai.

Qadam 6: Directrix aur latus rectum
(3) ki directrix: \(Y = -a = -1\), yaani
\[y + \dfrac{3}{2} = -1\]
\[y = -\dfrac{5}{2}\]
(1) ki directrix hai. Latus rectum ki lambai \(= 4a = 4\).
Kyun: upar khulne wale parabola ki directrix vertex ke neeche hoti hai, \(Y = -a\) par.

Qadam 7: Sketch
\(V\left(2, -\frac{3}{2}\right)\) aur \(F\left(2, -\frac{1}{2}\right)\) plot karein, axis \(x = 2\) aur directrix \(y = -\frac{5}{2}\) kheenchein, aur \(V\) se upar khulta curve banayein jo \(x = 2\) ke gird symmetric ho. Latus rectum ke ends \(x = 2 \pm 2\) par, yaani \((0, -\frac{1}{2})\) aur \((4, -\frac{1}{2})\), curve ki chaurai sahi rakhne mein madad dete hain (Figure 6.13).
Kyun: latus rectum ki lambai 4 hai, is liye focus ke dono taraf 2, 2 units.

Tasdeeq:
Point \((4, -\frac{1}{2})\) lein: \(16 - 16 + 2 - 2 = 0\), yaani yeh (1) par hai. Is ka \(F\) se faasla 2 aur directrix se \(-\frac{1}{2} - (-\frac{5}{2}) = 2\). Barabar, jaisa definition kehti hai.
Saath hi \(V\) bilkul \(F\) aur directrix ke darmiyan hai: \(-\frac{3}{2}\) dono \(-\frac{1}{2}\) aur \(-\frac{5}{2}\) ka average hai.
blocks.answer: Focus \(\left(2, -\frac{1}{2}\right)\), axis \(x = 2\), vertex \(\left(2, -\frac{3}{2}\right)\), directrix \(y = -\frac{5}{2}\), latus rectum ki lambai 4; graph upar khulta hai (Figure 6.13).

blocks.alt: Graph of x squared - 4x - 4y - 2 = 0, an upward parabola with vertex V(2, -3/2), focus F(2, -1/2), dashed axis x = 2 and the horizontal directrix y = -5/2. It crosses the x-axis near x = -0.45 and x = 4.45 and the y-axis at y = -1/2.
blocks.caption: Figure 6.13: The parabola of Example 17 (original drawing after the textbook's figure)

blocks.title: Exam tip
blocks.text: 'Analyse the parabola' wale sawal mein aakhir mein paanch nataij list ki shakal mein likhein: vertex, focus, axis, directrix, latus rectum ki lambai; aur sketch mein \(V\), \(F\), axis aur directrix zaroor mark karein. Fori check: vertex hamesha focus aur directrix ke bilkul darmiyan hona chahiye.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
\(y^{2} - 6y - 8x + 25 = 0\) ko analyse karte hain. Is mein \(y\) square hai, to parabola daayen ya baayen khulega.
\[y^{2} - 6y + 9 = 8x - 16\]
\[(y - 3)^{2} = 8(x - 2)\]
\(Y = y - 3\), \(X = x - 2\) se \(Y^{2} = 8X\): \(4a = 8\), \(a = 2\), daayen khulta hai.
Vertex \((2, 3)\); focus \(X = 2\), yaani \((4, 3)\); directrix \(X = -2\), yaani \(x = 0\); axis \(y = 3\); latus rectum ki lambai 8.
Tasdeeq: vertex \((2, 3)\) focus \((4, 3)\) aur directrix \(x = 0\) ke bilkul darmiyan hai.

Ek dafa phir poora dhaancha dohra lete hain, kyun ke Exercise 6.3 ke Q1(v) aur Q6 isi par hain: (1) dekho kaun sa variable square hai; (2) us mein complete square karo; (3) doosri taraf se coefficient bahar nikal kar \(4a(\ldots)\) ki shakal banao; (4) naye \(X, Y\) rakh kar standard form pehchano aur \(a\) nikalo; (5) table se vertex, focus, directrix, axis parho; (6) wapas \(x, y\) mein le jao; (7) sketch banao aur check karo ke vertex darmiyan mein hai.

Kai students poochte hain ke kya \(X, Y\) wala qadam zaroori hai. Zaroori nahi, magar shuru mein bahut madad karta hai: is se aap ko yaqeen ho jata hai ke aap table ka sahi column parh rahe hain. Jab practice ho jaye to seedha \((x - h)^{2} = 4a(y - k)\) se vertex \((h, k)\), focus \((h, k + a)\) aur directrix \(y = k - a\) likh sakte hain.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Chaar standard forms: \(y^{2} = \pm 4ax\) (daayen ya baayen khulte hain), \(x^{2} = \pm 4ay\) (upar ya neeche).
2. Sab ka vertex \((0, 0)\), latus rectum ki lambai \(4a\); focus aur directrix vertex ke mukhalif taraf \(a\) units par.
3. Shift kiya hua parabola \((x - h)^{2} = \pm 4a(y - k)\) ya \((y - k)^{2} = \pm 4a(x - h)\): vertex \((h, k)\).
4. General equation ka tareeqa: complete square, \(X = x - h\), \(Y = y - k\), table se elements, phir wapas \(x, y\) mein.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. \(4a\) ko hi \(a\) samajh lena: \(X^{2} = 4Y\) mein \(a = 1\) hai, 4 nahi.
2. Wapas aate hue sign ki ghalti: \(Y = y + \frac{3}{2}\) se \(y = Y - \frac{3}{2}\) aata hai, \(Y + \frac{3}{2}\) nahi.
3. Directrix ko focus wali taraf rakh dena. Curve focus ki taraf khulta hai aur directrix se door.
4. Daayen taraf \(y\) (ya \(x\)) ka coefficient bahar na nikalna: \(k\) parhne se pehle \(4y + 6\) ko \(4(y + \frac{3}{2})\) banana zaroori hai.
